source_url.description: gov.cn notice the answer is based on

data_updated.description: Publication date of the newest notice in the dataset

resource.description: Is this package version safe to install? Dependency check for install safety before npm install, pip install or cargo add, for one exact npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io or Maven version. Returns vulnerable true/false and the OSV.dev advisories for that version (CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, GO and RUSTSEC vulnerabilities and OpenSSF malicious-package MAL- entries) with CVSS, affected ranges, fixed versions and links. Package names are case-sensitive. Data fetched live from OSV.dev (cached up to 1 hour).

example.name: lodash
example.source: OSV.dev (https://osv.dev). Excerpted and modified: details text omitted, affected ranges restructured and filtered to the queried package. Per-advisory license in `license`.

name.description: Package name exactly as published; matching is case-sensitive for npm (lodash, not Lodash; legacy names such as JSONStream keep their case). Maven uses groupId:artifactId, Go the module path. PyPI names are normalised.

vulnerable.description: true when at least one advisory affects this exact version

level.description: Source rating such as LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL

license.description: License of the source record, e.g. CC-BY-4.0

truncated.description: true if the upstream result had more pages than were fetched

data_fetched_at.description: When the data was fetched from OSV.dev (ISO 8601)

resource.description: Recent insider trading for a US public company: SEC Form 4 filings parsed into structured JSON. Look up by stock ticker (e.g. AAPL) or SEC CIK; returns every transaction in the 4 most recent Form 4 / 4/A filings: insider name and role, date, code (P purchase, S sale, A award, M exercise...), shares, price, shares owned after, 10b5-1 plan flag and filing link. No recent Form 4 returns an empty transactions list (charged); an unknown ticker or CIK is a free 404. Data from SEC EDGAR, fetched live.
resource.serviceName: SEC EDGAR Insider Trades and Filings

example.source: SEC EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/edgar), public filings data retrieved from data.sec.gov and sec.gov archives. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK-B. Pass ticker or cik, not both.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 320193

rule_10b5_1.description: Filer checked the Rule 10b5-1 trading plan box (null on older forms without it)

code.description: Form 4 transaction code: P purchase, S sale, A award, M exercise, F tax withholding, G gift...

price_per_share.description: null when the filing gives the price only in a footnote

transactions.description: Newest filing first, in filing order within a filing

data_fetched_at.description: When the filing list was fetched from SEC EDGAR (ISO 8601)
